art_provenance.cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 as a new square album-cover candidate for duohertz track Aurora Skipline. Keep its identifiable core idea: one continuous frequency ribbon visibly skips upward across four separate stepping platforms. Change the entire illustration into an original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage suitable for the duohertz electronic rhythm game. Image 2 is only a reference for print texture, bold black/warm-ivory contrast, coral and electric-cyan accent discipline; do not copy its double circular rings, lightning arrangement, or composition. Replace the soft 3D fantasy sky, floating islands, aurora, crystals and waterfalls with a near-black ink field, angular warm-ivory paper platforms, a single thick electric-cyan-to-coral wave arc, sparse large halftone dots, and a few offset yellow beat marks. Strong diagonal movement and large crisp silhouette readable at 100px square. Reserve lower 20 percent as dark uncluttered space for a separate local title overlay. Distinct and joyful for all ages, but graphic rather than pastel or photorealistic. No words, letters, logos, characters, copied game interface, excessive strobing, or tiny confetti. Deliver square 1:1 cover art.

Keep the same original high-contrast ink-and-paper comic-print look, large angular warm-ivory stepping platforms and one continuous electric-cyan/coral frequency ribbon visibly hopping upward. Recompose the action across the RIGHT two-thirds of a 1.9:1 landscape canvas; keep the LEFT third near-black, calm and uncluttered for type. Put exactly two crisp, high-legibility lines of text in that left third, with ample margins: first line 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan; second line 'Aurora Skipline' in warm ivory and larger. Spell exactly d-u-o-h-e-r-t-z, and A-u-r-o-r-a space S-k-i-p-l-i-n-e. No other letters, words, icons, logos or watermark. No fantasy sky, islands, crystals, gradients or copied game graphics.
